The '''Hewntree Hotel''' was located in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]]'s [[Whitestone City]], two blocks away from the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Whitestone City palace|palace]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] resided in a room on the hotel's sixth-floor, inside which she [[Diet/Legends|ate]] a [[trinn berry]] from her chamber's [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] bowl while looking through a window. After leaving the Hewntree Hotel to buy an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] toy, she tested it in her room.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hewntree Hotel appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
